package.name: object_tracker_cpp
package.description:
Multi-object tracker for the BFMC autonomy stack. Consumes 3D detections from object_detection_cpp (/perception/objects) and emits temporally smoothed, identity-stable tracks on /perception/tracked_objects.
Algorithm: ByteTrack adapted for 3D vehicle-frame positions — per-class greedy matching with a two-stage (high-conf / low-conf) split, 4D constant-velocity Kalman filter per track, tentative→confirmed→lost lifecycle, uint8 track-id pool. CPU-only, no GPU dependency.
